american_english: The main objective of this article is to analyze contemporary Nepali poems in which the marginalized are foregrounded. In this article, by identifying poems from representative poetry collections of contemporary times that give primacy to marginalized communities and classes along with thematic and ideological aspects, an analysis is carried out with examples. This article is based on the descriptive method. The present article has been rendered factual through contextual examples by utilizing an inductive analytical process. In this article, data have been collected through a library research process. In this study, poems of the later period focusing on the marginalized dimension and their empowerment serve as primary source materials. From this study, it is found that the theme and idea of Nepali society traditionally discriminating primarily on caste and gender grounds, discriminating across social, cultural, religious, political, and economic spheres, and marginalizing people by denying them access, has found expression in later Nepali poetry. From the present study, the conclusion is reached that later Nepali poetry, while exposing the plight of the marginalized, foregrounds marginalized classes and communities alongside the ideas that such communities must be brought into the mainstream, that solidarity must be expressed in a rational manner, and that priority must be given to them in all spheres.
